scope: One real ARM64 QEMU/HVF guest on the pinned public Boltons fixture; a deliberately wrong candidate emitted 8 KiB of stdout per case.
evidence_digest_method: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the ordered 14-element array of {return_code, stdout_sha256, passed}.
provenance_note: The local live probe loaded the pinned v2 asset directory; the asset binding is copied from that directory manifest. The task was date-refreshed, so this record does not claim an exact task-definition digest. Operational runs and the local probe script are excluded from release materials.
limitation: Single correctness probe. Its observed wall times are not used for any speed claim; no model training was measured.
